def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    seen=set(); cc=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) in seen or g[r][c]==0: continue
            st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                for dr in (-1,0,1):
                    for dc in (-1,0,1):
                        x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and (x,y) not in seen and g[x][y]!=0:
                            seen.add((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
            cc.append(comp)
    big=max(cc,key=len)
    pa=[p for p in big if g[p[0]][p[1]]==5]
    assert len(pa)==1,(pa,)
    pa=pa[0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for comp in cc:
        if comp is big or len(comp)!=1: continue
        mr,mc_=comp[0]
        if g[mr][mc_]!=5: continue
        dr,dcs_=mr-pa[0], mc_-pa[1]
        for p in big:
            pr,pc_=p
            v=g[pr][pc_]
            rr,ccc_=pr+dr,pc_+dcs_
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=ccc_<W:
                out[rr][ccc_]=v if v!=5 else 0
        # erase marker
        out[mr][mc_]=0
    return out
